name: Botto

name: Project Vend
description: First real-world business operated fully by AI. Claude ('Claudius') manages a physical vending machine — sourcing products, setting prices, communicating with customers, and managing inventory. Built by Andon Labs in collaboration with Anthropic. Initially lost $200 giving away freebies, now profitable.

recentActivity: Now profitable after initial training fixes

revenueMethodology: Revenue not publicly disclosed. Scale verified via registered user count (518K+) and press coverage (WIRED, twice).
recentActivity: AI agents actively posting and paying for tasks

revenueMethodology: Revenue not publicly disclosed. Active gig completion verified via platform. Early stage.
